title: Portugal at the World Cup
description: From Eusébio's brilliance to Ronaldo's legacy — how well do you know Portugal's World Cup story?

questions.q: What is Portugal's best ever World Cup finish?
questions.explain: Portugal finished third at the 1966 World Cup in England, beating the Soviet Union 2–1 in the third-place play-off.

questions.q: Who won the Golden Boot at the 1966 World Cup?
questions.explain: Eusébio was the tournament's top scorer with 9 goals, including four in one match against North Korea.

questions.q: How many goals did Eusébio score at the 1966 World Cup?
questions.explain: Eusébio scored 9 goals — a remarkable haul that included a stunning solo effort in the quarter-final comeback against North Korea.

questions.q: In which year did Portugal make their World Cup debut?
questions.explain: Portugal qualified for their first ever World Cup in 1966 and immediately made an impact, finishing third.

questions.q: Against which team did Cristiano Ronaldo score his first World Cup hat-trick?
questions.explain: Ronaldo scored three goals in a dramatic 3–3 draw with Spain at the 2018 World Cup, including a stunning free kick in stoppage time.

questions.q: Who scored a hat-trick as Portugal thrashed Switzerland 6–1 at the 2022 World Cup?
questions.explain: Goncalo Ramos replaced the dropped Ronaldo in the starting XI and scored a sensational hat-trick in Portugal's biggest ever World Cup win.

questions.q: Which team knocked Portugal out of the 2022 World Cup quarter-finals?
questions.explain: Morocco beat Portugal 1–0 with a header from Youssef En-Nesyri, becoming the first African nation to reach the World Cup semi-finals.

questions.q: At the 2006 World Cup, Wayne Rooney was sent off and Cristiano Ronaldo was controversially seen winking. What was the result?
questions.explain: After Rooney's red card and a 0–0 draw, Portugal beat England on penalties. Ronaldo's wink to the bench after Rooney's sending-off became iconic.

questions.q: Who managed Portugal to their third-place finish at the 2006 World Cup?
questions.explain: Luiz Felipe Scolari (Big Phil) managed Portugal from 2002 to 2008, guiding them to the semis in 2006 where they lost to France 1–0.

questions.q: Who did Portugal beat in the third-place play-off at the 1966 World Cup?
questions.explain: Portugal defeated the Soviet Union 2–1 in the third-place match, with Eusébio scoring a penalty.
